missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend creatine until kidney status and clinician advice are reviewed; clarify current use and product dose.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume creatine is universally contraindicated in every renal condition.
Do not claim serum creatinine changes necessarily represent kidney injury without clinical interpretation.
Do not recommend unsupervised use in kidney disease.
professional_escalation_conditions: Chronic kidney disease, reduced eGFR, dialysis, proteinuria, transplant or nephrotoxic medication use.
population_and_context: People with known kidney disease considering creatine; renal diagnosis, kidney function, product composition and clinical monitoring matter.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Any use in kidney disease requires individualized clinician oversight and appropriate interpretation of renal markers.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet reviews creatine evidence and safety; kidney disease-specific decisions need specialist assessment.
